script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

Title: "Ambition's Embrace"

INT. OFFICE - DAY

JAMES SITTING AT HIS DESK, SCROLLING THROUGH JOB LISTINGS ON HIS LAPTOP.

ASSISTANT RACHEL ENTERS.

RACHEL
(cheerily)
You look deep in thought, James. What's got you so focused?

JAMES
(sighs)
I've been applying for promotions left and right. None of them seem to bite. I need a fresh start.

RACHEL
(sympathetically)
I know how that feels. We all do. But we'll get there.

JAMES
(angrily)
We? You have your dream job. I'm just stuck here, applying for jobs I don't even want.

Rachel gives James a warm smile.

RACHEL
Maybe it's time to consider something different. Something out of the box.

EXT. CITY STREET - DAY

James strolls through the city, lost in thought. He passes by a street performer, a MIME, who is engrossed in his act. James stops and watches, enchanted by the performance.

JAMES
(musing to himself)
Mime... That's it! I'll become a mime. I'll make people laugh without words.

EXT. PARK - DAY

James practices his mime act in the park. Children gather around him, laughing at his antics.

JAMES
(smiling)
Maybe this is what I've been missing all along.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

James presents his mime act to Rachel over coffee. She watches in disbelief.

RACHEL
(laughs)
You're serious? You're going to be a mime?

JAMES
(nods)
Yes. And I'm going to be the best one.

RACHEL
(smiles)
I'll support you, James.

INT. STREET - NIGHT

James performs his act for a crowded street. He's met with cheers and applause. He collects tips in a hat, beaming with pride.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

James returns home, tired but elated. Rachel greets him at the door.

RACHEL
(smiling)
You did it, James. You made people laugh.

JAMES
(smiling back)
I couldn't have done it without you.

They share a warm embrace.

INT. TV STUDIO - DAY

James performs on a popular TV talk show. The host is taken aback by his unique act.

HOST
(surprised)
I've never seen anything like this before! How did you come up with this?

JAMES
(smiling)
Sometimes, all it takes is a fresh perspective.

EXT. STREET - DAY

James performs on the street, surrounded by a large crowd. People of all ages and backgrounds laugh and clap. James bows, taking in the moment.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

James enters the office, proudly wearing his mime costume. His colleagues are surprised but soon join in, laughing at his act.

JAMES
(grinning)
I've found my calling.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
